$comment: Every difference from the frozen 1.35 public API (contracts/api-surface.json) must be listed. Removals/changes: { entry, name, change: removed|changed, reason, approvedBy, date }. Additions: { kind: "add", export: "<entry> <name>", reason, approvedBy, status? }; approvedBy may be null only with status "pending-gate" (signed by Jason at the Phase 0 gate). An agent never fills in approvedBy. goldenChanges: approved changes to how a golden part (history|persistence) reads: { part, reason, approvedBy, date }.
